tasks.task: Run the daily order and exception watch

items.when: Every working day, first thing, before the first carrier collection
When you have the morning's order and tracking export and need the late and stuck ones listed
When the watch should run each morning and hold risky orders only on the owner's say
When the store is connected, to find shipped orders with stale tracking before customers ask
When there is no tracking routine, to decide what to track at each step and when to alert

tasks.task: Write delay, lost parcel and peak season messages

items.when: When each stage of a delivery problem needs an honest, calm message, plus banner and auto-reply text
When updates should send themselves, to plan the flow, the tracking page and the delay script
When a message reads stiff or too sorry, to try it in another tone with the facts unchanged
Before the set goes live, to check every date, cut-off and promise against carrier and store terms
When customers still write in after the update, to find the effort the message leaves them with
When the store sends email and text from Klaviyo and the delay flow will be built there

tasks.task: Reply to customers upset about a delivery

items.when: When a parcel is late, lost or damaged and the customer needs a reply and a next step today
When a batch of messages arrives, to read tone, urgency and warning signs first
When the first draft sounds defensive, to get a version that names the feeling and promises nothing false
When the customer asks for money back, to give a clear yes, part or no under the policy
Before sending, to check the promises, facts and tone of the reply
When replies are sent from a Gorgias inbox and order facts should be pulled in there

tasks.task: Build a carrier claim pack and keep the claims log

items.when: When a parcel is lost or damaged and the claim needs the carrier's own evidence list and deadline
When the shipment is freight, to get next steps, a claim checklist and draft notices
When stock went missing at Amazon, to find the claims worth filing from the reports
Before a claim is filed, to tie every value, date and weight to a document
When a carrier denies a fair claim, to plan the appeal call around their side of it

tasks.task: Review shipping and fulfilment costs from invoices

items.when: When carrier invoices and the order export are to hand and the true cost per order is unknown
Each month, once the carrier invoices for the month are in
When you need what is charged for shipping against what it costs, by carrier and method
Before a carrier invoice is paid, to match its lines and list amounts to question
Before the review goes to the owner, to catch broken formulas and wrong totals

tasks.task: Compare carriers and prepare the rate talk

items.when: When shipment data is to hand, to set delivery times and costs side by side by carrier
When freight invoices show mixed lanes, to pick the best mode and carrier for each
When rates are up for talks, to get a bid plan, talking points and a carrier scorecard
When a carrier contract is due, to plan notice dates and keep, renegotiate or replace
Before the rate call, to sum up the carrier's position and plan the questions to ask

tasks.task: Set a shipping rate table and free-shipping line

items.when: Before setting rates, to know the true cost per order by zone and weight
When parcels, costs and countries are known and you need zones, rates and a free-shipping line
When the free-shipping line is a guess, to set it at the real peaks in order size
When flat, tiered and free shipping are all possible, to compare two models with the money shown
After the table is entered, to find zones with no rate or only manual rates

tasks.task: Write packing specs and fix box sizes

items.when: When breakages, crushed boxes or size-based billing are costing money
Each month, to see which products drive damage refunds and what to fix first
When 3PL quotes are laid out differently and must be put on one basis
Before asking for quotes, to write the pricing request and the agreement terms to demand
When a 3PL bill arrives, to find overcharges against the rate card and draft a dispute note
When moving warehouse, to plan notice dates and a staged switch that drops no orders
When deciding in-house or 3PL, to ask what the partner adds and when cash moves

tasks.task: Plan delivery zones, routes and run sheets

items.when: When a local business runs its own vans and needs zones, days, fees and a printable run sheet
When each drop has a promised window, to route so every window is met with the fewest vans
When several drivers share the day's drops, to get a low-mileage route for each
When the load is tight, to check fit, weight and the order things come off
When drivers also collect returns, to bring them back on the same trip
When cost per drop is too high, to rank the changes and ways to cut failed deliveries

tasks.task: Write the pick, pack and dispatch SOP

items.when: When orders go out wrong or each packer works their own way, or a new packer starts soon
Before writing, to find the slow steps and compare picking methods
When the steps need a flowchart, who does what and the edge cases written out
When the SOP is drafted, to test it for gaps and make a short deck for new packers
When errors repeat, to watch one order from shelf to label and look at each hand-off

tasks.task: Plan shelf and bin layout from order data

items.when: When pick counts are known, to put fast sellers in the closest spots
When a room or unit is being set up, to plan zones, aisles and storage type
When the layout is drawn, to test picker paths against one-way aisles and travel rules

tasks.task: Set up the returns bench and grading rules

items.when: When returns pile up, refunds wait too long or damaged returns go back on the shelf
When the policy itself is unclear, to set refund timing, keep-it rules and a recovery budget
When the bench is running, to see days from return request to refund and the late ones
Each month, to see what returns cost, which products drive them and the one fix to make
When returns stay high after the bench is fixed, to find the wrong-fit buyers behind them

tasks.task: Plan for peak season before it hits

items.when: When the busiest season is coming and stock, staff, carriers and cut-offs need dates
When past sales and a peak target are known, to plan support hires, 3PL terms and inbound stock
When ticket data is to hand, to work out cost per ticket and hiring dates for peak
When the owner must choose between adding staff and capping orders, to compare two plans
When last year's questions are known, to write the peak season FAQ from them

tasks.task: Get goods ready to cross a border

items.when: When an order or a supplier shipment crosses a border and terms, duty and papers must be settled
When you need likely tariff codes, duty options and the papers customs will ask for
When freight, duty and supplier invoices are in, to get true landed cost per unit
Before ordering, to test cost per sellable unit and margin from the quote and freight
When the product or route is new, to list the trade rules that apply and who owns each

tasks.task: Track inbound shipments and compare freight quotes

items.when: When speed changes stock-out risk, to compare chronological lost sales for each goods-ready and open-PO scenario
When purchase orders are on the water, to build a shared tracker and a warehouse notice
When freight quotes differ in what they include, to compare them with every charge counted
When goods arrive short or wrong, to match order, receipt and invoice line by line

tasks.task: Run stock counts and explain the differences

items.when: When counts happen only at year end, to set a rolling schedule and who counts what
When the count and the system disagree, to split timing, unit and real loss
When the store shows negative or impossible stock, to find where the counts drifted

tasks.task: Report delivery, claims and store numbers

items.when: Each month, to bring cost per order, claims won and lost and late rates onto one page
When you need days from dispatch to delivery by carrier and place
When the weekly summary needs revenue, units and order value by sales channel
When the owner wants one screen showing delays, low stock and orders at risk
When the same numbers are needed every week and should be rerun, not rebuilt

tasks.task: Write the delivery and returns information page

items.when: When real customer questions about delivery are to hand and need one clear page
When shipping and returns policies exist, to find gaps, clashes and unclear wording
When policies are long, to get plain versions customers and AI assistants can quote
Before publishing, to read the page as a shopper and mark each promise with no source

always.when: Before any SOP, message or claim goes out, to catch typos and a carrier or service named two ways
When a carrier or store export is messy, to clean and reconcile it before any figure is quoted

helpers.when: When the problem is stock: forecasts, reorder points and supplier lead times
When delivery questions need a full help centre or macro set, not one message set
When rates, markets, duties at checkout or tracking pages must be set up in the store
When the cost review needs order-level profit by channel, product and customer group
When the fix is a new box, insert or mailer design, not only a packing rule
When goods are dangerous, restricted or need licences, or product safety rules apply

gaps: No library item builds a parcel carrier claim pack with each carrier's evidence list and deadlines; only freight is covered
No library item matches parcel carrier invoice lines to orders to find surcharges, wrong weights and late-delivery refunds
No library item writes a packing spec or picks box sizes to cut dimensional weight charges and breakage
No library item sets own-van delivery zones with days, fees and cut-offs, or prints a driver run sheet
No library item checks routes against drivers' hours and break rules
No library item writes a returns bench SOP with grading rules for resale, refurbish or write-off
No library item covers dangerous goods in parcels, such as lithium batteries, aerosols and perfume
No library item helps choose and word an Incoterms rule, or explains duties and taxes to a buyer at checkout
No library item sets proof-of-delivery and photo rules that win more carrier claims
No library item builds a peak season calendar of carrier cut-offs and last order dates
No library item offers clearly different versions of a delay or lost parcel message set to compare
